rows.en: Never slack off on your efforts. Work hard!
rows.notes: Hilda, end of the trial-course extra lesson.

rows.en:
(I'd better review this properly later
so I don't forget what I learned today.)

(I can't believe it's already been over a year
since I started at Mihoshi Academy High School.)
rows.notes: x18: the player's monologue in both versions (and a 'single' copy). The extractor also files 14 pushes of this pool string under '???' speakers between their lines; it reads as the player's line, so it is kept gender-neutral and in the player's voice.

rows.en: (Sigh... Time really flies...)

(This past year I even ended up joining S.M.S.
It's been one whirlwind of a year...
No wonder the time seems to have flown by.)

Hey, what's with that spaced-out look,
\p?
rows.notes: ??? (man) = Alto (his caption follows; the player answers him).

rows.en:
Alto Saotome
A former kabuki prodigy who played female roles.
His looks earned him the nickname 'Princess Alto.'

I was just thinking it's really been over
a year since I started at Mihoshi.

Now that you mention it...
It's already been a year since I switched
to the Pilot Course, huh...
rows.notes: Alto. Tenka = transferring course (Pilot Course per glossary).

rows.en:
Whoa, whoa.
Why are you getting all nostalgic too, Alto?

Michael Blanc
An honor student with the top grades in the Pilot
Course. Loves teasing Alto until he blows up.
rows.notes: Full name as in the Japanese (Mihaeru), glossary 'Michael Blanc'.

rows.en:
Well, it really has gone by fast, though.
I remember starting at Mihoshi
like it was only yesterday.

Luca Angeloni
Heir to the major corporation L.A.I.
Skipped grades and is a whiz with computers.
rows.notes: Onzoushi = son and heir of a big company.

rows.en:
There were so many fun events, like the Culture
Fest, that the time just flew by, didn't it?

I go to a different school from all of you...
I wish I'd gone to Mihoshi with everyone~

Ranka Lee
A girl who loves to sing and dreams of becoming
a singer. A huge fan of top idol Sheryl.

Going to a different school doesn't matter,
Ranka-san! Just having tea with you like this
is a big event for me!!

Nanase Matsuura
A classmate in the Mihoshi Academy Art Course.
Adores Ranka and works with her at Nyan-Nyan.

Th-that's right!
For me too, having tea with Michel and everyone...
rows.notes: ??? (woman) = Klan, micronized (her caption follows). Trails off as in the Japanese.

rows.en:
Klan Klang
Has a 'clumsy gene' that makes her childlike when
micronized. Michel's childhood friend.

...Personally, I'd rather be enjoying tea
with some more beautiful older ladies.

Grr... Michel!
You two-timing cad! Stay right there!!
rows.notes: Futei = unfaithful; soko ni naore = stay there and take your punishment.

rows.en:
Heh heh. Those two
are the same as ever.
They never get tired of it, do they...

Seems to me Alto and Michel are always
doing the same kind of thing, though.
rows.notes: Muttered aside, names in the third person as in the Japanese; Alto catches it next row.

rows.en: Did you say something... \p?
Nothing at all...

Hee hee.
I hope we can all have fun together
like this again this year.

(Like Ranka said, I hope we can
all have fun together this year too...)

(Well, with a fun crowd like this around,
it's bound to be a blast.)

(All right! This year too, I'm giving it my all
at both school and my S.M.S. work!!)
(Sigh... Time really flies...)

(This past year I even ended up joining S.M.S.
It's been one whirlwind of a year...
No wonder the time seems to have flown by.)

I was just thinking it's really been over
a year since I started at Mihoshi.

There were so many fun events, like the Culture
Fest, that the time just flew by, didn't it?

Seems to me Saotome-kun and Michel-kun are
always doing the same kind of thing, though.

(Like Ranka-chan said, I hope we can
all have fun together this year too...)

(With a fun crowd like this around,
it's bound to be a blast.)

(All right! This year too, I'm giving it my all
at both school and my S.M.S. work!!)
All right! That's it for today's class!

(Today was the first class of the new year,
so I'm glad it was just orientation.)

Hilda V. Bergen
Mihoshi Academy High teacher in charge of
'Basic Training.' A cool beauty, strict with students.
rows.notes: Class names as in the campus help text (u5460 basic training, u5459 practical training).

rows.en:
From the next class on, I'll be as strict as ever!
Brace yourselves!

Harsh as ever, isn't she...
Well, hang in there, you guys.

Gary Murdoch
Mihoshi Academy High teacher in charge of
'Practical Training.' A big brother to his students.
And what are you doing, coming to watch my class?

I don't have a class this period.
I was bored, so I came by to watch.

Bored... you say......?
I believe I asked you to set up the equipment
we're using in the next class?

......Oh, I just remembered I've got something to do.
See ya!

Get back here, Gary!
Why, you...!!

(Gary-sensei's getting chewed out
by Hilda-sensei again...)
Haha, Gary-sensei never changes, huh.

Yuuto Kagura
A classmate in the Mihoshi Academy Pilot Course.
Loves to train.

But it kind of looks like they're both
enjoying it, don't you think...

Miyuki Shirakawa
Pilot Course classmate at Mihoshi Academy. An elite
from a military family, and Kagura's childhood friend.

Mm-hmm, mm-hmm. One of those shady
grown-up affairs, I'd wager.
rows.notes: ??? (woman) = Hoshimura (her caption follows); old-man diction (-desu naa) per glossary.

rows.en:
Yui Hoshimura
A classmate in the Mihoshi Academy Pilot Course.
An energetic girl who loves tinkering with machines.

Hoshimura...
Don't you ever say that in front of Hilda-sensei.
Not even nine lives would be enough...
rows.notes: Inochi ga ikutsu atte mo tarinai.

rows.en: Heh. Truth is, those two, back in the day...

Luis Fernando
A mysterious figure who often shows up at Mihoshi
Academy. A hot-blooded man overflowing with passion.

Y-you sure showed up out of nowhere...
Luis-san...

I can't quite explain it, but my passion told me
I'd better make an appearance right about now.

So? So? What happened in Hilda-sensei and
Gary-sensei's past? Tell me, Luis-cchi~
rows.notes: Luisu-cchi: Hoshimura's cutesy nickname suffix, kept in romaji like the honorifics; not in the honorific table.

rows.en:
Heh, if you're gonna beg like that, I can't refuse.
It happened some years back, on Gallia 4...

\p, Hoshimura,
we'd better head back to the classroom
or we'll be late for the next class.

Awww!
And just when the story was getting good~!!

Yui, don't be difficult.
Come on, let's hurry back to class.

Well, Luis-san, sorry to leave in the middle
of your story, but we have to go.

Heh, hit the books hard,
boys & girls!

(Okay, I'd better hurry back to the classroom
and get ready for the next class...)

(Still, Luis-san...
How does he know about Hilda-sensei
and Gary-sensei's past?)
(Now I'm curious...)

(Today was the first class of the new year,
so I'm glad it was just orientation.)

(Gary-sensei's getting chewed out
by Hilda-sensei again...)

Yui...
Don't you ever say that in front of Hilda-sensei.
Not even nine lives would be enough...
rows.notes: Female player calls her Yui, the male player Hoshimura (c24254).

rows.en:
Heh, hit the books hard,
boy & girls!
rows.notes: Female version: the Japanese says 'boi & gaaruzu' (one boy, Kagura, with three girls); kept deliberately.

rows.en: (Now I'm curious...)

uncertain: c24199: extractor attributes extra pushes of this string to ??? speakers; treated as the player's monologue.
